name: RadioCard
summary: One choice among a few options drawn as cards with a title, text, an optional icon and end content such as a price.
useWhen: Two to six options that each need a title, a line of text and a price or a date: plans, shipping, delivery slots
A choice that is the main decision on the page, where a bigger target helps
Options side by side on a wide screen that stack on a phone
avoidWhen: Options that are a word or two each
Seven or more options, or a list that grows
A card that opens a page or runs an action

insteadUse.A card that opens a page or runs an acti: Card with a Button or a link

value.description: The checked value, controlled. On RadioCardItem, the value that card sets (required).

defaultValue.description: The checked value at first render. No default: a group starts with none checked.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when a person picks a card.

disabled.description: Disables every card. On RadioCardItem, that card only.

required.description: Sets aria-required on the group and required on the hidden inputs.

invalid.description: aria-invalid and the danger border on unchecked cards. Point aria-describedby at the message.

name.description: The form field name of the hidden native inputs.

orientation.description: vertical: one card per line. horizontal: a grid of cards that wraps, one per line on a phone.

size.description: Padding, title size, circle size (14, 16, 20 px) and icon size.

tone.description: neutral: the checked card takes the text color. accent: the primary fill and border.

loop.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last card to the first.

title.description: RadioCardItem: the visible name. It is the accessible name.

description.description: RadioCardItem: a line or two under the title. Joins aria-describedby.

icon.description: RadioCardItem: a system icon name or a node before the text. Decoration, aria-hidden.

end.description: RadioCardItem: a price or a date at the inline end. Read after the description.

a11y.role: radiogroup on the root, named by aria-labelledby or aria-label; radio on each card, named by its title
a11y.focus: One tab stop for the group. Tab lands on the checked card, or the first enabled card when none is checked. Focus shows a 2px ring around the card.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the group at the checked card, and on to the next control
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus back out of the group
keys.ArrowDown: Moves to the next card and selects it
keys.ArrowUp: Moves to the previous card and selects it
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move to the card on that side and select it, in either orientation. They follow the reading direction: in Arabic ArrowLeft moves to the next card.
keys.Space: Selects the focused card when it is not checked

a11y.announce: Each card is read with its title as the name, then the description and the end content through aria-describedby, its checked state and its position. The group name comes from the heading aria-labelledby points at.
notes: Behavior from Radix RadioGroup. Each card is a button with role radio, so the whole card is the target. A hidden native input per card posts the value with the form.
No source: designed from the dials table in PLAN.md 3.7, RadioGroup and the card radius of the active style.
Checked is never color alone: the border doubles in width and the indicator fills with a dot.
The accent border uses color.primary.border, which keeps 3:1 against the page (WCAG 1.4.11) where the yellow does not.
A card holds text only. No link, button or input inside a card: the card is a button.
Disabled uses native disabled: a disabled card leaves the arrow order and draws with opacity.disabled.
Read only does not apply: show the chosen card as text instead.
The group has no legend part: put a heading above it and point aria-labelledby at it, or use aria-label.

en.title: A noun or a short phrase in sentence case: Team, Express delivery.
en.description: One or two lines that tell the cards apart: what is included, when it arrives.
en.end: A price or a date, short: $12 a seat, Free, Tomorrow.
en.heading: A short noun or question above the group: Plan, Shipping.

ar.title: اسم أو عبارة قصيرة بدون تشكيل: الفريق، توصيل سريع
ar.description: سطر أو سطرين يوضحون الفرق بين الخيارات
ar.end: السعر أو الموعد بالأرقام الغربية: 45 ر.س، مجاني

angular.behavior: div[dsRadioCard] and button[dsRadioCardItem], hand built with the Radix RadioGroup DOM on the CDK FocusKeyManager and Directionality, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The group host is the root (role radiogroup), the item host is the card button (role radio). Inputs take the React prop names; onValueChange is the valueChange output of [(value)]. title and description take text, icon takes an icon name or a TemplateRef, end takes text or a TemplateRef. aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are inputs on the item, because React merges them with its own ids. Behavior as RadioGroup, from behavior/roving-radio.ts. Inside a form the item inserts the hidden native radio after its host, where Radix renders it. Works with reactive and template forms. RadioCard.css is used as is.

styles.studio: A transparent card with the control border and the card radius; checked adds an inset line that doubles the border, in the text color, and a quiet fill. accent: the circle takes the translucent primary fill with the control border, and the checked card border keeps the control color, so the doubled border and the dot carry the state.
styles.desk: The same card in Instrument Sans; accent fills the circle with the yellow primary and draws the checked border in the primary border color.

mistakes.wrong: A button or a link inside a card
mistakes.right: Text only in the card; put actions outside the group

mistakes.wrong: Cards for options that are one word each
A checked card shown only by a color change
mistakes.right: RadioCard draws the thick border and the filled indicator; keep both in a recipe
A heading above it with aria-labelledby, or aria-label
A Select or a number Input
